name: Community Town Hall
description: Public forum template for capturing community concerns, commitments, questions, and accountable follow-up.

sections.title: Event Context
sections.instruction: Date, location or modality, hosts, topic, audience, and estimated attendance

sections.title: Opening Message
sections.instruction: Summarize the host's framing, goals, constraints, and commitments made at the start

sections.title: Community Questions
sections.instruction: List questions asked, who asked if appropriate, response given, and whether follow-up is needed

sections.title: Sentiment & Themes
sections.instruction: Summarize recurring themes, emotional tone, trust issues, priorities, and areas of alignment

sections.title: Commitments Made
sections.instruction: List commitments, promises, policy positions, deadlines, and accountable parties

sections.title: Unanswered Questions
sections.instruction: Capture questions or concerns not fully answered during the town hall

sections.title: Follow-up Communications
sections.instruction: List updates, documents, meetings, or announcements that should follow the event
